articles.chapeau: rand Theft Auto VI is finally available to preload on PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series X|S, giving players nine days to download up to 212GB before the November 19 launch.
articles.txt:
After years of waiting, multiple delays, and countless rumours, Grand Theft Auto VI is finally coming to players’ consoles. Starting today, November 10 , those who have preordered Rockstar’s highly anticipated open-world game can begin downloading it on PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series X|S.
But before you get too excited, you have to remember that this isn’t the full release. While you can download the game right now, you’ll have to wait until November 19 to actually play it. According to Rockstar’s official support page , preloading begins at different times depending on your console. PlayStation 5 users can start downloading at midnight in their respective time zones, while Xbox Series X|S owners get access simultaneously worldwide at 12 am GMT on November 10.
For American Xbox players, preloading technically began on November 9, at 7 pm ET or 4 pm PT.
Rockstar Games Vice City is calling, but you better have a lot of storage Before you rush to download the game, it’s worth checking if your console has available storage. Rockstar confirms that GTA 6 requires up to 212GB of free space , depending on the console. So if you already have a bunch of large games installed, this might mean you have to uninstall one or two of them. Fortunately, getting the preload started is relatively straightforward.
On PS5, navigate to your Game Library, select GTA 6, and check the countdown timer to enable automatic downloading. You’ll also need to make sure your console is powered on or in Rest Mode with automatic downloads enabled. Xbox owners should enable automatic updates and leave their consoles powered on or in Sleep Mode. If you’ve already preordered the game, check your game library for the available download.
The preload should save players from having to download the entire game when it officially unlocks, but there will most definitely be additional updates that should drop on launch day.
Rockstar Games The wait is almost over GTA 6 officially launches on November 19, 2026, for PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series X|S, taking players back to Vice City and the sprawling state of Leonida. But as we get closer to the release, there’s a major question hanging over the release.
As I reported yesterday , PlayStation backend references have revealed potential multiplayer functionality, but Rockstar still hasn’t announced a successor to GTA Online. So the focus clearly remains on Jason and Lucia’s adventure in single-player. With just nine days separating the preload from launch, Vice City’s long-awaited return is finally within reach for me.

articles.t: GTA 6 disponible en préchargement : voici comment l'installer avant la sortie
articles.chapeau: On vous explique comment vous préparer au mieux pour le 19 novembre.
articles.txt:
La date du 19 novembre est cochée dans le calendrier de millions de fans de jeux vidéo à travers le monde. Il s’agit de la date de sortie officielle du jeu probablement le plus attendu de tous les temps : GTA 6. Le titre développé par Rockstar Games aurait dû débarquer sur le marché le 26 mai avant de voir sa date de lancement décalée de plusieurs mois. L’attente touche à sa fin pour les joueurs, qui peuvent même commencer à télécharger GTA 6 sur leur PS5 ou leur Xbox Series dès maintenant.
Le préchargement de GTA 6 est disponible dès ce 10 novembre sur PS5 et Xbox Series. Cela signifie que vous pouvez commencer à installer le jeu sur votre machine si vous l’avez précommandé sur le PlayStation Store, le Microsoft Store ou que vous avez reçu votre version physique contenant un code de téléchargement.
Ce préchargement 9 jours avant la sortie officielle n’est pas du luxe étant donné que GTA 6 pèse 212 Go sur PS5 et 225 Go sur Xbox Series. Les joueurs non équipés de la fibre en ont pour plusieurs heures avant de compléter l’installation. Les vidéos de gameplay partagées par Rockstar ces derniers mois suffisent à comprendre pourquoi GTA 6 pèse aussi lourd. Le jeu impressionne déjà par ses performances techniques.
Rappelons également que GTA 6 ne sera pas disponible sur iPhone et Mac , pas assez puissants pour supporter un titre aussi gourmand en ressources graphiques. Rockstar plancherait uniquement sur le lancement d’une version PC pour le premier trimestre 2027.
Vous pouvez toujours précommander GTA 6 sur PS5 et Xbox Series afin de lancer le préchargement avant la sortie officielle prévue le 19 novembre.
Dans GTA 6, vous incarnerez Jason et Lucia , un couple plongé au cœur d’un complot criminel s’étendant dans tout l’État de Leonida. Les fans retrouveront la ville fictive de Vice City, découverte dans les précédents volets de la licence culte.

articles.t: GTA 6 Xbox leak hints at display and audio features PlayStation users won't get as preload goes live
articles.chapeau: While PlayStation has been touted as the best way to play GTA 6, a physical copy leak hints at Xbox having an advantage with Dolby Vision and Dolby Atmos.
articles.txt:
The big day is finally here, and we're in the end zone for the next Grand Theft Auto. It's been 13 years since GTA V raced into our lives and changed the world of video games forever.
Becoming the most profitable entertainment product of all time, GTA V 's success has been propped up by GTA Online and the fact that it still makes over $1 million a day.
The bar is in the stratosphere when it comes to GTA VI , but with it supposedly making $751 million in preorders alone, and tipped to make $5 billion in its first week alone, something tells us Rockstar Games will be just fine.
GTA VI has inadvertently reignited the gaming wars, with a fierce debate over whether PlayStation or Xbox is the ultimate way to play. Now, a physical copy leak has potentially crowned Xbox as the winner.
There's been a lot of chatter about the PlayStation 5 Pro being the definitive way to play GTA VI , with the upcoming automotive adventure even boasting a 'PS5 Pro Enhanced' label on the PS Store. Sony has done a massive marketing push to promote its souped-up credentials, and we've seen accusations of scalping as PS5 Pro console prices have soared well beyond their $900 MSRP.
We already covered how your base console can get something of a PS5 Pro-inspired boost thanks to a few simple changes, while the addition of FSR 4.1 could give the Xbox Series family its own mid-generation refresh, but that's only if Rockstar decides to add it to GTA VI .
Continuing the good news for the green team, a GTA VI box leak seemingly reveals that the game will support Dolby Vision and Dolby Atmos on Xbox. Whereas the PlayStation 5 version relies on standard HDR10, Dolby Vision produces more accurate colors.
Basically, premium TVs that support Dolby Vision can use frame-by-frame dynamic metadata to automatically balance peak brightness and make those vibrant neon signs of Vice City really pop.
Elsewhere, PlayStation relies on its Tempest 3D Audio engine that can pass a Dolby Atmos signal over HDMI to an external soundbar, meaning it's converted instead of being a native part, and there can be some spatial translation gaps.
Xbox treats Dolby Atmos as a native system-wide audio engine that maps objects into a 3D space, optimizing it for home cinema setups.
Chances are that you already have your console of choice by now, and with just nine days to go (at the time of writing), you can officially preload GTA VI ahead of November 19. Both PlayStation and Xbox will require 212 GB of storage, so you'd better start clearing out those games you haven't played in a while.
GTA VI preloads were originally penciled in for November 12, but giving us a bit of extra time to prepare ourselves, they're going live on November 10.
This means anyone who has pre-ordered a digital copy of the game will be able to download it and jump straight back into Vice City when GTA VI goes live on November 19.
Whereas PlayStation owners have a staggered regional rollout from 12:00 AM local time on 10 November, Xbox went with a global simultaneous launch from 12:00 AM GMT.
For physical copy owners, copies are supposed to start shipping or arriving from November 12, meaning you can preload via the code inside your box.
There's plenty of time to get yourselves ready for the GTA VI launch, but make sure you don't miss the boat on what could be the biggest entertainment launch of all time.

articles.t: GTA 6, installez-le sur Xbox sans avoir reçu votre boîte
articles.chapeau: Les joueurs Xbox peuvent lancer le préchargement de GTA 6 depuis leur smartphone sans posséder le jeu dans leur bibliothèque numérique.
articles.txt:
Rockstar Games GTA 6, le préchargement est possible sans avoir acheté la version numérique Florian Prache Publié le 10 Novembre 2026 à 11h22 2 minutes de lecture Ajoutez-nous à vos sources sur Google Suis toute l’actualité gaming sur WhatsApp Sommaire GTA 6 peut déjà être installé sur Xbox sans posséder le jeu Comment télécharger GTA 6 depuis l'application Xbox sur smartphone ? Télécharger GTA 6 ne permet pas d'y jouer gratuitement Résumer l'article Résumé rapide de l'article
Le préchargement de GTA 6 a débuté ce mardi 10 novembre 2026 dès 1h00 sur Xbox Series X|S. Mais saviez-vous qu'il est possible de télécharger le jeu sans même l'avoir acheté sur le Microsoft Store ou reçu votre version en boîte ? Nous avons testé une méthode directement depuis l'application Xbox sur smartphone, permettant de lancer le téléchargement des 209,86 Go avant de recevoir son code d'activation.
Depuis ce matin, les joueurs ayant précommandé GTA 6 en version numérique peuvent commencer à télécharger les fichiers sur leur Xbox Series X|S.
Mais les joueurs ayant choisi une édition en boîte, notamment sur Amazon , devront patienter jusqu'à la réception de leur commande, dont les premières livraisons sont attendues à partir du 12 novembre 2026 .
Il existe pourtant une méthode permettant de prendre de l'avance , même sans avoir acheté le jeu sur le Microsoft Store.
Nous avons réalisé la manipulation et celle-ci fonctionne parfaitement. Grâce à l'application mobile Xbox, il est possible de demander à sa console de télécharger GTA 6 à distance, sans disposer du jeu dans sa bibliothèque.
Lors de notre essai, le téléchargement affichait 209,86 Go , une taille particulièrement importante qui justifie de s'y prendre plusieurs jours avant la sortie.
La manipulation est relativement simple et ne nécessite aucun VPN ni achat supplémentaire . Voici les étapes que nous avons suivies :
Le téléchargement se lance alors sur votre console, sous réserve qu'elle soit correctement configurée, connectée à Internet et dispose de suffisamment d'espace libre.
Pour activer les fonctionnalités à distance si nécessaire, rendez-vous dans les paramètres de votre Xbox, puis dans Appareils et connexions > Fonctionnalités à distance .
Une connexion au même réseau Wi-Fi peut faciliter la configuration initiale, mais elle n'est pas obligatoire pour déclencher une installation à distance une fois la console associée.
Attention à ne pas confondre installation et possession du jeu. Cette fonctionnalité Xbox permet uniquement de récupérer les fichiers en avance.
Pour lancer GTA 6 à partir du 19 novembre 2026 , il faudra toujours posséder une licence valide, qu'elle provienne du Microsoft Store ou d'un code fourni avec une édition en boîte.
Microsoft propose d'ailleurs cette possibilité de téléchargement à distance depuis plusieurs années, même pour les jeux qui n'ont pas encore été achetés.
Pour ceux qui ont commandé leur exemplaire chez un revendeur, cette manipulation permet surtout de gagner plusieurs jours de téléchargement et d'éviter de devoir récupérer plus de 200 Go à la dernière minute.
Une fois votre code reçu, il ne vous restera qu'à l'activer sur votre compte Xbox et à patienter jusqu'à l'ouverture officielle du jeu le 19 novembre.

articles.t: “Les résultats dépassent largement nos attentes” : GTA 6 est déjà un carton avant sa sortie, voici la première info révélée par Take-Two Interactive
articles.chapeau: Take-Two Interactive indique que les préventes de GTA VI ont déjà dépassé les attentes du développeur. Celui-ci ne partage pas de chiffre, mais une estimation des revenus générés par GTA VI avant sa sortie circule déjà, et c’est énorme.
articles.txt:
GTA VI , considéré comme le jeu vidéo de la décennie, ne sera disponible que le 19 novembre. Mais, en attendant, Take-Two Interactive, la maison-mère de Rockstar Games, célèbre déjà une petite victoire. Pour rappel, le jeu est en prévente depuis juin. Et si Take-Two préfère ne pas partager de chiffres, pour le moment, son CEO Strauss Zelnick assure à nos confrères de Variety que les préventes dépassent largement les attentes de l’entreprise.
“C’est une bonne chose. Cela dit, on ne crie jamais victoire avant qu’elle ne se concrétise” , a-t-il cependant tempéré, expliquant que les fruits du travail de l’entreprise seront réellement visibles après le lancement. Strauss Zelnick a aussi indiqué que Take-Two donnera plus de détails sur les performances financières de Grand Theft Auto VI après le lancement.
Si Take-Two préfère ne pas donner de chiffres, pour le moment, des données circulent déjà sur la toile. La société Sensor Tower a suivi les préventes de GTA VI. Et, d’après ses estimations, 7,71 millions de copies auraient déjà été vendues au 3 novembre 2026, ce qui aurait généré 751 millions de dollars. La majorité de ces ventes proviendraient des joueurs sur PlayStation 5, qui auraient une part de 74 % sur les revenus, contre 26 % pour les consoles Xbox compatibles avec le jeu (pour rappel, la version PC n’a pas encore de date de lancement ).
On ne sait pas non plus combien Take-Two a dépensé pour développer GTA VI. Mais l’entreprise a déjà indiqué que le développement de son nouveau jeu vidéo n’a pas dépassé les 1,5 milliard de dollars qui étaient évoqués par les rumeurs.
En tout cas, tout le monde s’attend à ce que ce jeu vidéo, qui succèdera à GTA V lancé en 2013, soit un véritable phénomène culturel. Pour rappel, la présentation du titre sur Netflix avait, par exemple, fait planter les serveurs du SVOD. Et, aux États-Unis, l’opérateur Xfinity s’attend à ce que la période du 10 au 19 novembre soit la semaine la plus chargée jamais enregistrée sur son réseau, à cause des joueurs qui vont se précipiter pour précharger le jeu vidéo.

GTA 6 preload goes live, and data mining reveals PSSR 2 support and 120Hz mode for PS5 Pro
articles.chapeau: You can now preload GTA 6, and data miners are busy digging into the game's files. A couple of PS5 features have been spotted.
articles.txt:
PC Guide is reader-supported. When you buy through links on our site, we may earn an affiliate commission. Read More Table of Contents Latest tech deals. PSSR in GTA 6 spotted for the second time After waiting for more than a decade, PS5 and Xbox Series X/S users will finally be able to dive into GTA 6 soon, as the game will launch on November 19. In the past few months, Rockstar Games has shared a lot of new information about the game, including gameplay details, screenshots , and more. And now, new information discovered in the game’s preload data suggests the PS5 Pro could receive some interesting enhancements.
Preloading is currently live (as of midnight on November 10), meaning those who purchased GTA 6 can start downloading the game files, ready for when the game launches. In the meantime, some players have already started examining the game’s files and metadata to uncover hidden details.
One of them is GTAForums user Tex2 , who discovered that GTA 6’s preload data includes references to a 120Hz High Framerate mode. This is interesting, considering there have been concerns about whether the game will be able to run above 30 FPS, even on the more powerful PS5 Pro. However, it’s worth noting that the presence of a 120Hz mode doesn’t translate to 120 FPS, as the game could still be locked to 30 FPS on the Pro model.
Grand Theft Auto VI will support a newer version of PSSR, per @TexFunz2 Source: https://t.co/tOLJJGXloF pic.twitter.com/CftvmwvayG
The user has also made a major discovery related to PlayStation Spectral Super Resolution, popularly known as PSSR. The preload data reportedly references PSSR version 13.60, which is newer than the 13.00 version used by games such as Cyberpunk 2077. In other words, Sony could be preparing a newer version for GTA 6 that could deliver better image quality or performance. PSSR support was already seemingly confirmed last week, when some PS5 marketing info went live earlier than expected.
The metadata also reportedly includes references to a CPU High Frequency mode, which could help the console handle some of the game’s more demanding tasks. That said, none of this confirms that GTA 6 will offer a 40 FPS or 60 FPS performance mode. The new information comes from preload metadata, and Rockstar has not officially confirmed anything about the game’s graphics settings yet.
Abdul is a tech writer and Editor for PC Guide, specializing in all things tech, gaming, and hardware.

articles.t: GTA 6 pre-orders are ‘far above initial expectations’ but NBA 2K27 was ‘below our forecast’, Take-Two says | VGC
articles.chapeau: NBA was still the second most successful launch in the series’ history…
articles.txt:
Take-Two says pre-orders for Grand Theft Auto 6 are “far above initial expectations”, but its other recent major release NBA 2K27 hasn’t met its forecast.
Despite delivering “the second highest net bookings performance in the history of the series” and selling more than 4 million copies since its release in early September, NBA 2K27 “was below our forecast for the period”, according to the publisher.
It expects big things from GTA 6 , however, stating: “Pre-orders for Grand Theft Auto VI are tracking far above our initial expectations, and we know that the numbers will speak for themselves soon enough.”
Despite this claim, Take-Two has only modestly revised its forecast for the financial year, adjusting its range from $7.9 – $8.1 billion up to $7.98 – $8.18 billion.
In an interview with GamesIndustry.biz, Take-Two CEO Strauss Zelnick said the company was not yet adjusting its guidance because the game is so close to release.
“[We cannot] disclose the numbers, but the point that we’re making is our prior expectations obviously were aligned with our guidance, and the pre-orders are far exceeding our original expectations,” Zelnick said.
“We’re maintaining our guidance, because the release is only 10 days away and we’ll know a lot more after the release.”
When asked whether the decision to keep the guidance at around $8 billion for the year was a sign that Take-Two wasn’t predicting a bigger than expected launch, Zelnick reiterated: “We’re just not updating our numbers right now because we are so close to the launch. However, pre-orders are far exceeding our expectations.”

articles.t: GTA 6 can be pre-loaded without pre-ordering, and here's how
articles.chapeau: It's really easy 👀
articles.txt:
GTA 6 pre-loads are now live, but some users can install it without actually pre-ordering it.
Grand Theft Auto VI pre-loads are officially live allowing those who’ve pre-ordered the game to get it installed and ready to play come November 19. However, even those who haven’t pre-ordered can benefit.
This week we’re imagining gamers are amid a mad dash to clear their backlog and make space for GTA VI , and if you’re looking to maximise the free space on your hard drives, there are some handy tips to consider.
Once you’ve got an adequate amount of room, around 220GB, you’ll be able to install the game early so you can jump right in on launch day, provided you actually own the game.
It’s worth keeping in mind though that Xbox users don’t even need to pre-order the game in order to pre-install it.
As community members like u/undead_revolver on Reddit realised, the Xbox mobile app will let you install any game you want even if you haven’t bought it.
You obviously won’t be able to boot up the game until it’s been unlocked and purchased, as your console will search for a license as it’s loaded, but it’s worth keeping in mind.
Who is this going to benefit though? If you pre-ordered the game digitally, it won’t make a lick of difference as you can pre-install the game now anyway, but if you’ll be waiting for a ‘physical’ copy to arrive, this should benefit you.
The ‘physical’ version of the game doesn’t include a disc annoyingly, but many gamers want it anyway for the box alone, and there’s also talk of a collector’s map/double-sided poster being included as well.
Pre-installing through the above Xbox method means as soon as you get the download code, you can input it into your console and immediately start playing rather than waiting for it to install then and there.
If you didn’t know any of this before, you do now. It’s worth remembering for games other than GTA VI too. This method is also handy for those who don't want to purchase until reviews drop.
READ NEXT: GTA 6 prompts US internet provider to offer free upgrade to improve launch day download speed
Those installing GTA VI right now are only getting the main game, i.e. the story mode. However, Grand Theft Auto fans have been rummaging through the PlayStation 5 Store’s code, and found clues hinting at the next iteration of GTA Online .
There’s talk of joinable player sessions and while that doesn’t mean GTA VI will have an online mode at launch, it at least suggests Rockstar Games is getting it ready. It’s also rumoured that GTA Online will be a standalone download.
We’re not expecting that to have any impact on the game’s install size, as it’ll in theory use all of the same game assets. It should hopefully remain around the 210-230GB mark unless there are some major expansions to the map coming.
GTA VI will finally launch on PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series X/S on November 19, and then all eyes will be on Rockstar to drop the PC port.

articles.txt:

With its release just nine days away , Grand Theft Auto VI is now available for preloading on Xbox Series X|S and PlayStation 5 in most regions around the world. This means that once you pre-order the game, you'll be able to fully install it to your console's drive ahead of the November 19th release. Given GTA 6 's huge 212GB file size and reported pre-release sales already around 8 million copies , pre-loading would certainly help you avoid any rush.
Publisher Rockstar Games staggered the game's digital preloading schedule, starting yesterday at 7 PM EST for Xbox Series X and S owners. If you have a PS5 or PS5 Pro console, preloading opened at midnight today local time (November 10) across all regions. For those with a physical copy of GTA 6 , it will start shipping and arrive at retail stores on November 12th. A box in the code will allow you to preload the game as soon as it arrives.
GTA 6 's reported 212GB file size could pose an issue for many users. Even if you own a 2TB PS5 Pro, it's going to use a lot of your space. And if you have a standard 512GB Xbox Series S console, the game will take up more than half of the approximately 362GB of usable storage. Preloading will thus allow users to make sure their storage is organized and ready for the download, something that will be doubly important if there's a day-one patch.
If you're on Xbox and pre-ordered GTA 6 , you can start preloading by going to the Microsoft Store, searching for Gran Theft Auto VI and selecting install. You can also pre-download by enabling "Keep My Games & Apps Up to Date" in the Settings > System > Updates section. On PS5, find and select the preload option on the PlayStation Store's GTA 6 page. You can set it to automatically download the game by going to your Game Library, selecting the GTA 6 pre-order and toggling the Auto-Download setting on.
Give yourself plenty of time, as a 212GB could take hours to load depending on your connection speed. To get started, you'll first need to order the game: Grand Theft Auto VI costs $80 for the Standard Edition and $100 for the Ultimate Edition, on the Xbox or PlayStation stores, along with retailers including Amazon and Walmart .

articles.t: GTA 6 sur PC : Take-Two renvoie à Rockstar et promet un GTA « radicalement différent »
articles.chapeau: À quelques jours de GTA 6, Strauss Zelnick parle PC, disque, GTA Online, piratage par IA et avenir de la série, mais laisse les annonces à Rockstar.
articles.txt:
Interrogé par Variety sur une version PC, un portage sur Switch 2 ou une vraie édition sur disque de GTA 6, Strauss Zelnick , le patron de Take-Two , a répondu que « l'information vient toujours de nos labels » . La parole reste à Rockstar. GTA 6 sort le 19 novembre sur PS5 et Xbox Series.
Aucune version PC n'est annoncée. Au rythme de Red Dead Redemption 2 (treize mois entre la console et le PC) ou de GTA V (dix-neuf mois), un portage PC tomberait entre fin 2027 et mi-2028, mais ce n'est qu'une estimation. Les éditions en boîte contiennent un code de téléchargement ; aucune édition sur disque n'est annoncée. Take-Two fait état de précommandes « de loin » supérieures à ses attentes. Zelnick attend du jeu qu'il « fixe un nouveau niveau de référence » pour l'éditeur. Quant à un nouveau report, il l'écarte d'une phrase à IGN : « Il ne sera pas repoussé une nouvelle fois. »
La question de l'après revient depuis que Phil Hooker, l'un des trois responsables du développement de GTA 6 , a assuré à Bloomberg que le prochain jeu de Rockstar ne prendrait pas huit ans de plus, grâce aux outils bâtis pour GTA 6. Relancé par IGN, le patron de Take-Two ne cite ni titre ni date : « Nous pensons que la nature et le rythme des contenus de nos franchises phares, GTA compris, seront radicalement différents au cours de la prochaine décennie . » Il l'explique par la volonté de toucher les joueurs « de nouvelles manières et à de nouveaux endroits » puis de les garder actifs après la sortie.
Insider Gaming en a conclu que GTA 7 prendrait moins de temps que GTA 6. Zelnick ne parle pas de GTA 7. Le mot « contenu » peut désigner des extensions ou des mises à jour en ligne autant qu'un nouvel épisode. Il confirme aussi l'avenir de GTA Online : « Nous comptons continuer à le soutenir. Il a énormément réussi, il a très bien résisté et n'a cessé de grandir au fil des années. »
Des clones de jeux générés par IA circulent depuis des semaines, au point qu'une version de GTA 5 a tourné dans un navigateur le mois dernier avant d'être retirée. S'y ajoute la course au jailbreak de la PS5, qui fait craindre une copie pirate de GTA 6 jouable sur PC peu après sa sortie. Devant les investisseurs, Zelnick rappelle que la taille des fichiers et la connexion aux serveurs ont longtemps protégé les jeux du piratage, puis admet que « cela va devenir plus difficile ». Take-Two se dit « entièrement concentré sur le renforcement de [ses] défenses techniques et de [ses] actions en justice ». Le piratage devrait selon lui toucher l'activité « dans une plus ou moins grande mesure ». Il le croit « gérable ».
À IGN, il dit ne pas y voir de menace financière pour Take-Two et range le piratage parmi les questions « créatives ». Presque tout le monde veut selon lui « l'expérience Rockstar telle que Rockstar l'a voulue ». Interrogé sur les mesures d'Anthropic pour limiter la copie de jeux existants avec Claude, il estime que chacun devrait protéger la propriété intellectuelle. Pour des entreprises dont le métier est la propriété intellectuelle, comme Anthropic et OpenAI, il juge « ironique de piétiner celle des autres d'un côté en espérant que la sienne soit protégée ».
Red Dead Redemption 2, le précédent jeu du studio, en est à 89 millions d'exemplaires vendus en huit ans. Le pré-téléchargement de GTA 6 est ouvert depuis le 10 novembre ; les horaires de lancement en France sont dans notre guide de l'heure de sortie .

articles.chapeau: Rockstar's servers are almost certain to be under heavy strain on November 19. That's why the game's preload is starting today. This means players can download GTA 6 ahead of its official release, ensuring that most of the game files are already on their devices by launch day. That way, they won't have to wait for the entire download to finish while dealing with overloaded servers.
articles.txt:
GTA VI is officially set to launch on November 19. By then, every interested player will be eager to jump into the game. Millions of people who preordered the game or plan to buy it on day one will flood the servers with download requests. Delays, outages, and slow download speeds are therefore to be expected.
To help ease this initial surge in demand, Rockstar is launching the preload for Grand Theft Auto 6 on Xbox and PlayStation 5 today, November 10, 2026. While this doesn't necessarily mean you'll be able to play the game early, you can already start downloading most of its massive file size. This means that once the game unlocks on launch day, only a few remaining files or patches should need to be downloaded. In a way, this could actually give preload users an early advantage: while other players are still stuck waiting for their multi-gigabyte downloads to finish, those who preloaded the game may already be playing.
According to an official PlayStation announcement, you'll need at least 212 GB of free storage space on your PS5. You'll also need a PlayStation or Xbox account and, of course, a preorder – meaning you must have already purchased the game. For PlayStation users, the download should become available at midnight local time on November 10. On the Xbox Series X/S, however, the preload is not scheduled to become available until noon.
On PlayStation, the auto-download option must be enabled, and the console must be powered on or in Rest Mode rather than fully switched off. The same applies to Xbox: make sure auto-download is enabled and that your console is either powered on or in Sleep Mode so the download can begin. Once you've made sure there's enough free storage space on your console, you're all set to start downloading the game ahead of launch.

articles.t: Une fuite du boîtier physique de GTA 6 sur Xbox révèle de possibles avantages par rapport à la version PS5

Dolby Vision peut produire des couleurs plus fidèles que le HDR10 de la PS5. Les systèmes PlayStation transmettent des signaux Atmos via HDMI, mais s’appuient sur Tempest 3D pour l’audio spatial.
articles.txt:
Sony a présenté les consoles PS5 comme le meilleur moyen de jouer au nouveau titre de Rockstar . Certains propriétaires de consoles Microsoft se sont sentis délaissés au fil du déroulement de la campagne marketing . Pourtant, une fuite du boîtier physique confirme que la version Xbox de GTA 6 bénéficie d'avantages visuels et sonores exclusifs.
À l'approche de la date de sortie de GTA 6 , fixée au 19 novembre, des images du boîtier PS5 ont déjà circulé sur les réseaux sociaux. Au lieu d'une carte, Rockstar y a inclus un poster recto verso. Désormais, videotech a partagé le dos du boîtier Xbox, qui révèle des détails sur les formats vidéo et audio compatibles.
Les fidèles des Series X et S devraient pouvoir profiter du Dolby Vision et du Dolby Atmos en option. Le Dolby Vision peut présenter des avantages par rapport au HDR grâce à des métadonnées dynamiques optimisées pour des scènes spécifiques. Il en résulte des couleurs et des niveaux de luminosité plus précis dans les jeux et les films.
Au grand dam des passionnés de home cinéma, les consoles Xbox proposent le Dolby Vision, contrairement à leur rivale, la PS5. Les fans de PlayStation s’appuient sur le HDR10 , qui reste très performant. Quoi qu’il en soit, les marques de téléviseurs OLED comme Sony et LG mettent en avant le Dolby Vision comme argument de vente.
Bien que l’attention se soit surtout portée sur les graphismes, les projets cinématographiques de Rockstar offrent également un son immersif. Le boîtier physique de GTA 6 sur Xbox indique que l’audio spatial Dolby Atmos sera disponible sur les consoles de Microsoft. Les jeux utilisant cette technologie produisent des effets sonores positionnels précis qui reflètent l’action à l’écran.
À la demande des joueurs, la PS5 a ajouté la prise en charge du Dolby Atmos lors d’une mise à jour en septembre 2023. Malgré cela, les jeux sont d’abord calibrés pour l’audio Tempest 3D de Sony , avant que le son ne soit converti en Atmos. Le résultat final varie et peut être tout aussi impressionnant, voire supérieur. Néanmoins, de nombreux auditeurs préfèrent l’autre solution dans les installations surround dotées d’enceintes en hauteur.
Les révélations sur la version Xbox de GTA 6 ne devraient pas modifier l’ important écart de ventes en précommande rapporté. Les fuites liées au préchargement laissent entendre que la PS5 Pro offrira une fréquence d’images ou un taux de rafraîchissement plus élevé. Pour le reste, les analystes s’attendent à des performances comparables sur la Series X et la console PS5 de base .

articles.t: GTA 6 Preorders Beat Forecasts as NBA 2K27 Falls Short
articles.chapeau: GTA 6 preorders are tracking far above Take-Two's plan before the Nov 19 launch, while NBA 2K27 missed its forecast. What the Q2 numbers mean for you.
articles.txt:
Take-Two says GTA 6 preorders far exceed its plan 10 days before the Nov 19 launch, but net bookings fell 18% to $1.6B as NBA 2K27 missed. Here's why.
Take-Two Interactive says GTA 6 preorders are "tracking far in excess of our initial expectations," ten days before Grand Theft Auto VI launches on November 19, 2026. The publisher shared the update with its fiscal second quarter results on November 9, but it did not give a single preorder number.
The same report shows the other side of a GTA year. NBA 2K27 sold more than 4 million copies and still missed Take-Two's forecast, and CEO Strauss Zelnick believes GTA 6 itself is part of the reason.
Strong enough for Take-Two to use very big words. In the official earnings release , Zelnick said, "The launch of Grand Theft Auto VI is ten days away and, with pre-orders continuing to reach unprecedented levels, we expect to deliver an historic year for our company."
On the earnings call he added that "the numbers will speak for themselves soon enough." That is a polite way of saying the real figures come after launch. GTA VI arrives on PS5 and Xbox Series X|S, and Take-Two's lineup table still lists no PC version. If you have not set up your console yet, our GTA 6 preload guide covers start times and the 212GB download.
NBA 2K27 came out on September 4 and posted the second best net bookings in the series' history. Net bookings is Take-Two's main sales measure: everything it sold digitally or shipped to stores in the period. Even so, the game landed below the company's own target.
Zelnick told IGN, in comments reported by Kotaku , "It has been a crowded period, and we do think that GTA 6 coming has had an influence on the consumer." In other words, some players may be saving their money for Vice City. He was relaxed about it with Bloomberg: "If your lunch is going to be eaten, I'd rather be the one eating it." President Karl Slatoff was more careful on the call, saying "it's really hard to know exactly" why the game fell short.
The quarter ended on September 30, so it contains no GTA VI sales at all. Recurrent consumer spending, meaning money players spend inside games they already own (virtual currency, add-ons and in-game purchases), fell 9%. Take-Two had guided for a 5% drop.
Net bookings also missed Take-Two's own range of $1.62 billion to $1.67 billion, and Bloomberg says Wall Street expected about $1.65 billion. The full year outlook of $8.0 billion to $8.2 billion stayed the same, and the October to December quarter alone is guided at $3.35 billion to $3.50 billion. GamesIndustry.biz notes that operating costs should rise about 21% in that quarter, mostly because of GTA 6 marketing.
Mostly, it suggests November 19 is holding. Take-Two repeated its $8 billion forecast and its launch date ten days out, with no hint of another delay. Rockstar's older game is still a giant too: GTA V has sold nearly 235 million copies, and the GTA+ membership grew by double digits last quarter.
Expect heavy server traffic and a crowded launch week, much like the pressure Sony pointed to when it discussed falling PS5 sales ahead of GTA 6 . PS5 Pro owners also have something to look forward to, since a datamine points to a 120Hz mode for GTA 6 .
A publisher calling its own preorders "unprecedented" is not proof, so the real test is the first sales figure after launch. Still, the NBA 2K27 miss tells us something useful: GTA 6 is pulling money out of gamers' wallets before it even ships. For Take-Two, a weak quarter is the price of one of the biggest game launches ever, and it looks happy to pay it.

Few publishers attempt it, and fewer still pair it with an entry system this restrictive.

articles.t: Physical GTA 6 Xbox case leak reveals possible advantages over PS5 version
articles.chapeau: A retail packaging leak indicates GTA 6 supports Dolby Vision and Dolby Atmos on Xbox consoles. Dolby Vision can produce more accurate colors than the PS5’s HDR10. PlayStation systems output Atmos signals over HDMI, but rely on Tempest 3D for spatial audio.
articles.txt:
Sony has advertised PS5 consoles as the best way to play Rockstar’s new title . Some owners of Microsoft’s gaming systems have felt overlooked as the marketing campaign unfolded. Still, a leak of the physical case confirms the GTA 6 Xbox version has exclusive visual and sound perks.
Ahead of the November 19th GTA 6 release date , images of the PS5 retail box already spread on social media. Instead of a map, Rockstar enclosed a double-sided poster. Now, videotech has shared the back of the Xbox case, which reveals details on compatible video and audio formats.
Series X and S loyalists should expect Dolby Vision and Dolby Atmos as options. Dolby Vision can have advantages over HDR with dynamic metadata optimized for specific scenes. The result is more accurate colors and brightness levels in games and movies.
Frustratingly for home theater enthusiasts, Xbox consoles offer Dolby Vision, but rival PS5 hardware does not. PlayStation fans rely on the still-very-capable HDR10 . Regardless, OLED TV brands like Sony and LG promote Dolby Vision as a selling point.
Although much of the focus has been on graphics, cinematic Rockstar projects also have immersive sound. The physical GTA 6 Xbox case explains that Dolby Atmos spatial audio will be available on Microsoft’s systems. Games using the technology produce precise positional effects reflecting the on-screen action.
By popular request, the PS5 added Dolby Atmos support in a September 2023 update. Even so, games are calibrated for Sony’s Tempest 3D audio first, before it's translated to Atmos. The end product varies and can be just as impressive, if not superior. Nevertheless, many listeners prefer the alternative in surround sound setups with height speakers.
Revelations about the GTA 6 Xbox version are unlikely to change the reported large gap in pre-order sales . Preload leaks hint the PS5 Pro will provide a higher frame rate or refresh rate. Otherwise, analysts anticipate performance on the Series X and base PS5 console to be comparable.

Rockstar Games is one day from opening downloads for Grand Theft Auto VI . Pre-loading begins November 10, 2026, and the game launches November 19, 2026, on PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series X|S. Coverage from Cinelinx and Nintendo Life has framed the run-up as the build toward the biggest release in entertainment history, a label the publisher itself has not claimed.
That gap between headline and record book is the real story today. The confirmed facts are strong on their own: a $79.99 standard edition, pre-orders that opened at midnight local time on June 25, 2026, and a physical edition that ships as a download code with no disc. Our earlier look at the install-size claims circulating before preload showed how quickly unverified numbers spread when a release gets this big.
This analysis separates what Take-Two Interactive and Rockstar have actually confirmed from what the market is projecting. It covers the timeline, the price, the packaging, the money at stake for Sony and Microsoft, and four predictions for launch week. Anything the official sources do not state stays marked as unconfirmed.

Add Shattered once in the Google app and our stories show up in your news suggestions.
Start with the short list of facts that hold up under scrutiny. Grand Theft Auto VI is developed and published by Rockstar Games, a label owned by Take-Two Interactive Software, Inc. The release date is November 19, 2026. The launch platforms are PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series X|S. The standard edition costs $79.99.
Pre-orders began June 25, 2026, at midnight local time, which means players in each region saw the store pages open as their own clock rolled over. Pre-loading starts November 10, 2026, so anyone who ordered digitally can have the files on their console before launch day. Standard physical versions contain a download code and do not include a disc, per the official release information.
Take-Two describes the game as featuring “a single-player experience set in the biggest, most immersive evolution of the series yet.” That sentence is the closest the publisher comes to a superlative. It describes the game relative to earlier entries in the series. It makes no claim about the wider entertainment industry, and that distinction matters when headlines start to stretch it.
The table below sorts the public record into what is confirmed and what is not. Treat the second column as a watch list rather than a set of facts.
The GTA 6 release date has been stable in the official materials, and that consistency counts for something. Players have had months to plan around November 19. The only dated checkpoint left before launch is the preload window opening on November 10, and the three confirmed dates run in order: pre-orders on June 25, preload on November 10, launch on November 19.
Pre-loading is more than a convenience. When a download of this scale opens, network providers, console storefronts and publishers all see a demand spike days before the game even unlocks. A staggered preload spreads that load across the nine days before launch instead of concentrating it on the morning of November 19. Players who wait until launch day to start downloading take on avoidable risk.
Neither Take-Two nor Rockstar has published an official install size in the sources available to us. Numbers are circulating anyway, and they come from leaks. Until the storefronts show a size on the pre-load page, plan for a large download and free up space rather than trusting any single figure.
A $79.99 standard edition is a premium price for a console game, and it shows how much confidence Take-Two has in this title. Publishers rarely push a price up on a game they expect to struggle. Setting the number at $79.99 is a bet that demand will absorb it.
That bet has consequences beyond this one title. If buyers pay $79.99 without visible resistance, other publishers will read the result as permission to move their own flagship prices up. If buyers balk, the next round of pricing decisions across the industry gets more cautious. Analysts and rival executives will watch pre-order momentum and launch-week chatter for exactly this signal.

articles.chapeau: GTA 6 will only be available in digital format, but it also has a special collector’s edition with many “goodies” that does not include the game. It will also be possible to buy a boxed version…
articles.txt:
GTA 6 will only be available in digital format, but it also has a special collector’s edition with many “goodies” that does not include the game. It will also be possible to buy a boxed version, which has already been leaked.
The leaked version is for PS5 . The box is shown unopened, with both its front and back visible. The front features the design already seen in previous leaks, while the back includes screenshots and a description of Jason and Lucia in the first half, followed by information about the game in the second half.
The GTA 6 game cases are arriving with retailers and here is what’s included: – Game Case – A slip of paper with one side the cover art and the other the game code. – A slip of paper with an Ultimate Edition Upgrade prompt. – A double sided poster of the box art and cover girl. pic.twitter.com/8U8OsaQ5aB
The second half is where things get interesting, as it includes references to online features and DualSense support, including vibration and adaptive triggers. The box also states that GTA 6 requires 230 GB of free space on PS5, which is 18 GB more than Rockstar previously indicated.
This difference in storage requirements could be due to a last-minute change, such as the inclusion of a patch or update. It could be related to fixing bugs or even improving security against the threat of a jailbreak.
The box has also been opened to reveal its contents, and as expected, there are no discs. Instead, Rockstar includes a code to download the game, a leaflet encouraging players to upgrade to the “Ultimate” version, and a double-sided poster featuring the game’s official cover art on one side and the “Vice City cover girl” artwork on the other. Unlike previous Grand Theft Auto releases, however, the box does not include a physical paper map.
In other news, the ending credits for GTA 6 are reportedly expected to last over 80 minutes . In addition, PlayStation has accidentally published—and swiftly deleted—a product page revealing the PS5 Pro enhancements for GTA 6 .

articles.chapeau: PlayStation 5 database discoveries suggest Rockstar is preparing GTA 6 Online, but could its PC release be part of the plan?
articles.txt:
PlayStation 5 database discoveries suggest Rockstar is preparing GTA 6 Online, but could its PC release be part of the plan?
Grand Theft Auto 6 is almost here, but Rockstar Games still hasn't said much about what comes after its single-player campaign. That could be about to change, though, as discoveries in the game's PlayStation version suggest that work on GTA 6 Online is already underway.
This comes from ' PlayStation Game Size ', an account known for tracking PlayStation database updates and uncovering game information ahead of official announcements. In its latest findings, it identifies three multiplayer-related entries associated with GTA 6 : 'joinSession', 'launchActivity', and 'launchMultiplayerActivity'.
While that's encouraging for anyone anticipating the next evolution of GTA Online, it doesn't confirm that the mode will be available alongside the November 19 launch, or tell us when Rockstar plans to introduce it. Dataminer ' TexFunz2 ' claims that GTA 6's single-player and online components could be installed separately.
If that's accurate, players might eventually be able to remove the campaign while keeping the multiplayer experience installed, which would be particularly useful given the game's reported 210GB download size.
So, where does that leave the PC version? Rockstar hasn't officially announced one, but a recent report from GamesBeat cites four industry sources familiar with the studio's plans, claiming that it's targeting the first quarter of 2027. That would put the PC release just a few months after the console launch, a considerable improvement on GTA 5's PC port, which arrived around 19 months after its original release.
It's worth remembering that GTA Online originally launched two weeks after GTA 5 in October 2013, while Red Dead Online arrived roughly a month after Red Dead Redemption 2. Rockstar could take a different approach this time, considering that GTA 5's multiplayer was particularly rough at launch. Let's hope history doesn't repeat itself here.

articles.t: GTA 6 : une fuite dévoile le nombre de trophées, dix jours avant la sortie
articles.chapeau: Dix jours avant la sortie, les fichiers des plateformes ont parlé : 55 trophées au lancement, dont une énigme à 1 000 points. Rockstar, fidèle à son silence, n'a rien confirmé.
articles.txt:
Dix jours avant la sortie, les fichiers des plateformes ont parlé : 55 trophées au lancement, dont une énigme à 1 000 points. Rockstar, fidèle à son silence, n’a rien confirmé.
Rockstar verrouille la communication autour de GTA 6 depuis des années, malgré les fuites massives qui ont émaillé son développement. La liste des trophées vient pourtant de sortir par la bande, repérée dans les fichiers des plateformes de Sony et de Microsoft.
Le jeu arriverait avec 55 trophées sur PS5, platine attendue comprise, et autant de succès sur Xbox Series. Les deux plateformes racontent la même chose chacune de leur côté, ce qui donne du poids à l’extraction sans la confirmer. L’auteur du relevé a volontairement tu les noms, pour ne rien divulgâcher de l’histoire. À titre de comparaison, GTA 5 s’était lancé avec 49 succès sur Xbox 360 et 50 trophées sur PS3, Red Dead Redemption 2 avec 51 et 52. Le nouveau venu dépasserait donc ses aînés, d’une courte tête.
Sur Xbox, un jeu répartit d’ordinaire ses 1 000 points de score entre des dizaines de succès. La liste extraite aligne ici 54 entrées modestes, échelonnées de 1 à 54 points, auxquelles s’ajoute une entrée unique créditée de 1 000 points . Deux lectures circulent : un succès « mythique » , distinction rare que Microsoft réserve aux exploits hors norme, ou une valeur provisoire posée pour les tests internes. Une capture douteuse évoquait d’ailleurs 58 trophées l’an dernier ; ces chiffres extraits avant l’heure bougent parfois d’ici au lancement.
Impossible, à ce stade, de savoir si la liste couvre le seul mode histoire ou si le volet en ligne y prendra part plus tard. Rien ne dit non plus que tout sera décrochable dès le lancement. Le décompte renseigne de toute façon assez mal sur l’ampleur ou la difficulté réelles d’un jeu. Red Dead Redemption 2 et ses 52 trophées passent encore pour un platine particulièrement redouté.
Le préchargement ouvre comme prévu le 10 novembre à minuit sur PS5 et vers 1 heure du matin en France sur Xbox Series, avec un téléchargement qui grimpe jusqu’à 212 Go suivant la machine. Les acheteurs de versions en boîte devront patienter jusqu’au 12 novembre pour récupérer leurs codes chez les revendeurs. La sortie reste calée au 19 novembre sur les deux consoles , à 79,99 euros en édition standard et 99,99 euros pour l’Ultimate numérique ; le déverrouillage à minuit demeure officieux.
Lire aussi : Avant la sortie de GTA 6, Rockstar annonce une excellente nouvelle
La liste des trophées s’ajoute ainsi aux 25 minutes d’images de jeu parties dans la nature début octobre, dans l’indifférence publique du studio. Rockstar a bien confirmé, début novembre, les modalités du préchargement et le poids du téléchargement ; sur les trophées, silence complet. Rien ne garantit, d’ailleurs, que les valeurs repérées tiendront jusqu’au 19 novembre. Pour le joueur, le vrai rendez-vous reste la nuit du 10 : 212 Go à faire passer avant la ruée.

articles.t: GTA VI Trophies Leak: 55 Rewards Reported [2026]
articles.chapeau: Leaks put GTA VI trophies and achievements at 55 on PS5 and Xbox Series X|S. Rockstar has not confirmed the count or published any names.
articles.txt:
A new leak puts the reward list for Grand Theft Auto VI at 55 entries on each major console family. Reports from Notebookcheck, Neowin, Shane the Gamer, Root-Nation, Around Prague and eGamers.io all point to the same figure: 55 PlayStation 5 trophies and 55 Xbox Series X|S achievements. The number comes from datamined information, not from Rockstar Games, Sony or Microsoft.
That distinction drives everything below. Rockstar has not published a trophy or achievement list, any names, any descriptions or an official count. Players have seen a total and little else. Earlier leaks around this launch, such as the Xbox file size leak we covered, followed the same pattern of hard-looking numbers with no official sign-off.
This analysis separates what the reporting supports from what it does not. It also looks at why the story spread so fast, how PlayStation and Xbox reward systems differ, and what the leak means for the weeks before launch. Readers who follow our gaming coverage will recognize the approach: attribute every claim, label every guess.
Google · Preferred Sources Don't miss new tech stories on Google
Add Shattered once in the Google app and our stories show up in your news suggestions.
The headline number is simple. Reporting says GTA VI carries 55 trophies on PlayStation 5 and 55 achievements on Xbox Series X|S. Outlets describe the match across both platforms as the main reason the figure looks credible, since two separate sets of data landed on the same total.
Notebookcheck framed its write-up around the comparison with the previous numbered entry in the series, with a headline that says the new game has more PS5 trophies and Xbox achievements on release date than GTA 5 . Shane the Gamer ran a dedicated post on the 55 leak. Neowin, Root-Nation, Around Prague and eGamers.io carried the same core claim. None of these outlets quote Rockstar, Take-Two Interactive, Sony or Microsoft on the record, and none claim to hold the actual list.
So the verified portion of this story is narrow. A figure of 55 exists in leaked or datamined information. Several outlets reported it. Nobody with authority over the game has confirmed it. Every other detail attached to the story, from point values to hidden rewards, sits in softer territory, and the sections below mark that line clearly.
The wording matters for search readers too. People typing GTA VI trophies or GTA VI achievements into a search box want a list. This leak gives them a count. Anything promising names or unlock conditions at this stage deserves suspicion, because the fact sheet behind this report says no such details have been verified.
Datamining means pulling information out of game files, store back-ends or platform services before the publisher chooses to reveal it. For trophy and achievement lists, the data often sits in configuration files that platform holders need ahead of launch. Sony and Microsoft both require developers to register reward sets so the services can display them when a player unlocks something.
That plumbing explains why counts leak while content stays hidden. A system can know that 55 slots exist without exposing what each one is called. Reporting on this leak fits that picture. The count surfaced and the text did not, which is consistent with data that has been configured but not yet localized or made public.
It also explains why caution is warranted. Datamined values can be placeholders, test entries or leftovers from earlier builds. The reports we reviewed do not claim otherwise. They present the number as a leak and note that the official storefront listings are where confirmation would eventually appear.
A pattern from earlier in this launch cycle is worth recalling. Our piece on the build leak and its three online strings showed how fragments of data get read as proof of far more than they can support. The trophy story carries the same risk, only with friendlier stakes.
Sorting claims by confidence keeps the story honest. The table below groups every detail in circulation by how well the reporting supports it. Only the first three rows reach the level of confirmed reporting, and even those confirm that outlets reported a number, not that the number is final.
Three points hold up. The 55 figure comes from leaks and datamining. Rockstar has said nothing official about the list. The same total appears for PlayStation and Xbox. Those three facts are all a careful writer can state without hedging, and each depends on how the outlets frame

articles.t: GTA 6 Menu Music Surfaces as PS5 Preloads Begin
articles.chapeau: GTA 6's PS5 home-screen theme has surfaced as preloads opened in New Zealand. Here's what we know, and when UAE, Saudi and Egypt players can start.
articles.txt:
A calm, 80s-style synth track is the first real sound of GTA 6 on PS5, and your own preload window is closer than you think.
0:00 GTA 6 has made its first sound on console. Insider Gaming reports that PS5 preloads opened in New Zealand, and players there started posting clips of the game’s PS5 home-screen music: a soft, synth-heavy track with a distinct 80s feel. It plays when you highlight the GTA 6 icon, so you don’t need to launch anything to hear it.
One of the clips came from the @gtasix_ account, which called it the first listen to the GTA 6 main menu theme on PS5.
BREAKING: First listen to the GTA 6 main menu theme on PS5. pic.twitter.com/kowKEt55l6
Treat it as the dashboard theme for now. TweakTown notes that the track plays from the PS5 home screen and may differ from the music in GTA 6’s own menu. Insider Gaming expects the two to match, but that’s a guess until people can boot the game on 19 November.
Found us on Google? Add tbreak as a preferred source to see more of our stories in Top Stories.
The order comes down to time zones. According to Rockstar’s support page , PS5 digital preload begins at midnight local time on 10 November 2026, so New Zealand, which is among the first places to reach that midnight, got there first. Xbox Series X|S works differently, with a single worldwide start at 12am GMT on 10 November.
For readers in the Gulf and Egypt, that means PS5 players in the UAE can start downloading at midnight tonight, UAE time. Xbox owners get the same window at 4am in the UAE, 3am in Saudi Arabia and 2am in Egypt. Rockstar’s page also says the game itself still releases at midnight local time on 19 November on both consoles.
The date is earlier than originally listed. Pre-order details published in June pointed to a 12 November preload, which is the date in our pricing and editions coverage . gHacks reports that Rockstar’s Newswire has since moved it to 10 November and says the preload file needs up to 212 GB depending on your device.
Early readings from live consoles suggest you’ll want more than a token amount of free storage. RockstarINTEL cites an X user for a PS5 download of about 209.75GB (212GB installed) and roughly 225.34GB on Xbox Series X|S. It also says anyone with a boxed copy, which contains a download code rather than a disc, can queue the install from the Xbox phone app without waiting to enter the code.
The music is part of a wider push on the audio side. Rockstar’s launch trailer , published on 15 October, features music from the electronic duo Justice, credited as composers of the original score. The same description points to an official soundtrack album, GTA VI: The Album, which was open for pre-save at the time.
When can I preload GTA 6 in the UAE? On PS5, preload opens at midnight local time on 10 November, which is tonight in the UAE. On Xbox Series X|S it opens at 12am GMT, or 4am UAE time. Check that you’ve got 212GB or more free first, since Rockstar’s figure is “up to” and Xbox downloads are reported to be larger.
That’s unconfirmed. The track plays when GTA 6 is highlighted on the PS5 dashboard, and it may differ from the music in the game’s own menu.
No. Rockstar says GTA 6 releases at midnight local time on 19 November on PS5 and Xbox Series X|S, in all regions.
